page_title: OSA 1-2 ESP | Osasuna v Espanyol 17/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and sends a shot to the middle of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Marko Dmitrovic.
90+2' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

90+2' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. The linesman points to the corner flag, Osasuna are going to take it.
90+1' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) takes the corner which is cleared.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) was quite harsh and Miguel Ortiz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
88' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
87' Kike Barja (Osasuna) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.

87' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) produces an attempt from the edge of the box which would have most likely endangered the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players blocked it, so we can only speculate about the outcome.
85' Osasuna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
84' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
83' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
82' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) commits a rough challenge and Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle for a foul.
81' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the middle of the goal, but Marko Dmitrovic has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
80' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Valentin Rosier trots off the pitch and is replaced by Kike Barja (Osasuna).
76' Manolo Gonzalez decides to make a substitution. Pere Milla will be replaced by Ruben Sanchez (Espanyol).
76' Today's match ends for Tyrhys Dolan who will be replaced by Antoniu Roca (Espanyol).
75' The attendance is 21186.
74' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Javi Galan (Osasuna) but poses no threat.
72' Javi Galan (Osasuna) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marko Dmitrovic, who smothers the ball.
67' Substitution. Abel Bretones is replaced by Javi Galan (Osasuna).
67' Fernando Calero (Espanyol) sends a chip pass into the box, but Sergio Herrera is quickest to intercept the ball.
66' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a header into the top right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
66' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
65' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. Osasuna force their opponents to concede a corner.
64' Here is a change. Kike Garcia is going off and Manolo Gonzalez gives the last tactical orders to Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol).
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Exposito departs the field of play to be replaced by Fernando Calero (Espanyol).
64' Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle and it's Ante Budimir (Osasuna) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

64' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
63' A corner kick by Espanyol is thwarted by the well prepared Sergio Herrera (Osasuna).
62' Pere Milla (Espanyol) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The referee signals a corner kick to Espanyol.
59' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) was too forceful with his tackle and Miguel Ortiz interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
58' Here comes a substitution. Iker Munoz (Osasuna) is brought on as a substitute for Lucas Torro.
58' Substitution. Moi Gomez (Osasuna) has come on for Jon Moncayola.
58' Alessio Lisci has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Raul Garcia (Osasuna) replacing Aimar Oroz.

56' A cross by Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.
55' Here's the change. Pol Lozano leaves the pitch and Charles Pickel (Espanyol) comes on as a substitute.
53' 1 - 2 Goal! Pol Lozano produces a great pass that finds Kike Garcia (Espanyol) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom left corner. 1:2.
51' The referee blows his whistle as Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) was too aggressive in his challenge.

49' 1 - 1 Goal! Victor Munoz (Osasuna) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. Marko Dmitrovic is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 1:1.
49' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Osasuna.
48' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
47' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
46' Referee Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' The corner by Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.

44' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Osasuna.
43' Espanyol take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

42' Pere Milla (Espanyol) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. Corner kick. Espanyol will have an opportunity.
42' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Espanyol for a penalty. Play continues.
39' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
36' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Miguel Ortiz has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

35' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Victor Munoz (Osasuna) inside the box. He lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Marko Dmitrovic was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
34' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Kike Garcia (Espanyol) heads on.
30' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Osasuna.
30' The resulting corner from Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) is cleared by the defence.

27' 0 - 1 Carlos Romero (Espanyol) quickly gets to a rebound. He is not worried how far out he is and slams the ball towards goal. To the amazement of all, it goes all the way into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:1 with this magnificent strike.

26' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Miguel Ortiz with no other option than to blow for a foul.
22' Osasuna concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
21' Pere Milla (Espanyol) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post.
17' Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) commits a foul and Miguel Ortiz immediately signals a free kick.
17' A player from Espanyol commits a rough challenge. Miguel Ortiz blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
16' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
15' The resulting set piece from Osasuna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
13' Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
12' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Osasuna was in an offside position.
11' Great chance! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) controls a rebound inside the box. He only has the keeper to beat, but his shot flies just over the bar.
11' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) has tested the patience of referee Miguel Ortiz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
9' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) sends a cross into the box, but Sergio Herrera comes off his line to gather the ball.
8' Miguel Ortiz interrupts the game. One of the players from Osasuna won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
5' Half-chance! Kike Garcia (Espanyol) plays a pass into the box, but Sergio Herrera reacts well to snuff out the attack.
4' Exposito (Espanyol) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
3' A player from Espanyol commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
